constraints.figureJob: Show one human patient story being turned into grouped structure that decisions can use, without literalizing the transformation into a workflow table.
constraints.layout: Centered three-part horizontal composition: soft patient story field on the left, sculptural membrane chamber in the middle, and quiet decision-ready structure card on the right.

locked: Essential work that can start before the visit

left.label: Patient story
left.storyText: This started maybe three days ago. It’s worse when I’m walking around. I was up a lot last night because of it. I don’t think I’ve had a fever. I’ve had something kind of like this before.
